global_design_philosophy: SILENCE — the object speaks, the brand does not shout. Restraint, vast negative space, quiet precision.

display.usage: Editorial titles, house name ('Allélique' ALWAYS set in italic).

body.usage: Body text, UI elements, small notations. Small size on wide margins.

TrackedCaps.classes: font-sans text-[10px] md:text-xs tracking-[0.3em] uppercase text-cendre
TrackedCaps.description: Used for labels, notations (e.g. N° 053), and minor navigation.

EditorialWrapper.classes: min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col justify-center items-center px-6 md:px-24 max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center gap-12
EditorialWrapper.description: Provides the vast negative space. One idea per screen.

QuietLink.classes: inline-block border-b border-transparent hover:border-encre transition-colors duration-700 ease-out text-encre cursor-pointer pb-1

SangSeal.classes: w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-sang mx-auto flex-shrink-0
SangSeal.description: A single --sang accent per view. Can be a literal dot or part of a mark.

RadialMark.description: Thin-line radial living-system mark. Two concentric rings, central node, radiating lines. Inline SVG, stroke-width: 0.5px, stroke: var(--encre), fill: none.

Form.description: Forms use mailto action. No backend. Extremely minimal text inputs. Bottom border only, no bounding box. Focus state slightly thickens bottom border. Font: Inter.

images.description: Warm sunlight casting shadows on a beige wall. Used to represent 'The Host' essence.
Selective focus on white ceramic texture. Represents wabi-sabi, material mastery.
Rock in rippled water, black and white texture effect. Represents the scholar stone, monochrome.
Clear luxury glass perfume bottle, minimalist lighting. Represents the 'Grail' concept.
Group of minimal bottles in dramatic shadow. Represents bio-responsive skincare.

routes.layout: Full-viewport hero slowly rotating the three worlds (breath pace: 8-12s per world, 1500ms cross-fade). Minimal overlay: Radial mark, 'Maison Allélique', essence line, quiet scroll cue. Below hero: one screen stating 'We do not sell products. We compose ceremonies.' Vast space. Three restrained doorways to the worlds.
Vast space. Editorial introduction to the brand. One sentence per scroll block.
Four values + four traits as an editorial spread. Large title, one precise line each. Enormous space. 'N° 01–04' tracked-caps notation. Manifesto, not a feature list.
Index of the three lenses: The Host, The Master, The Observer. Quiet doorways.
Warm sand tones. Ritual, generosity, presence. 'The pour is short. A quarter cup means stay.' Mashrabiya geometry hints.
Material, mastery. 'The form is not designed. It is grown.' Kintsugi, raku, timber lattice. Cinnabar (--sang) seam accent.
Restraint, recognition. 'Nature creates. We recognise.' Monochrome + a single --sang seal. Scholar stone imagery.
One collection in three forms. Gallery narrative.
Personalised niche fragrance. Numbered editions (N° 0XX). Olfactory notes as gallery text. NO shop grid. Quiet route: Book Consultation.
Bio-responsive. Text-focused, highly clinical yet poetic. Quiet route: Request Access.
Collectible objects. Quiet route: Request Access.
Materials, traceability as trust cues. Naming raw materials like a museum exhibit.
Application form (invitation-framed). 'Our editions are limited and personal. Access begins with an introduction.' mailto integration.
Book a Private Consultation. Form capturing intent for Paris in-person or private video. mailto integration.
Press line: press@maisonallelique.com. Contact: contact@maisonallelique.com. Vast space.

layout_elements.header: Tiny, quiet top nav. Radial mark + up to five words (Maison, Worlds, Editions, Provenance, Access). 'Access' is accented (perhaps slightly darker encre or italic). Transparent background over hero, solid --os elsewhere.
layout_elements.footer: Every page. Radial mark, tiny nav, legal block: 'Responsible Person — Melissa SASU, 29 Rue d'Artois, 75008 Paris, France' + Privacy, Cookies, Terms. One discreet line.

accessibility.contrast: Use --encre for essential text against --os background to ensure WCAG AA/AAA. --cendre is strictly for non-essential/secondary notation.
accessibility.keyboard: Full keyboard nav required. Focus states should be a subtle 1px border of --encre.
accessibility.motion: Wrap animations in prefers-reduced-motion media queries to disable breathing/parallax if requested.

anti_patterns: NO e-commerce, NO cart, NO prices.
NO pop-ups, countdowns, or urgency signals.
NO autoplay audio or fast carousels.
NO crammed grids. Do not place multiple ideas on one screen viewport.
NO more than ONE --sang accent per view.
NO smiling stock models. Photography must be atmospheric materials/light.
NO generic sans-serif for headings (Must use Cormorant Garamond).

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.
